_comment: Modules loaded by each entrypoint before it can serve. This file may shrink freely; growing it past the tolerance means a new dependency tree arrived. See scripts/check_import_budget.py. Last raised for the GitHub App work: 8 first-party modules and zero third-party ones -- the App auth and installation services, the credential presenters, the shared webhook signature module, and the source-plugin port. Measured main at 4630/6407 against a 4585/6372 baseline before that, i.e. #598 had already spent 45 of the 50-module tolerance without raising it, so the number here had stopped describing anything. Raised again when the thirteen function_* settings moved to app/modules/function/config.py: that adds exactly one module (app.modules.function.config) to each entrypoint, and it cannot be lazy -- api/dependencies.py builds module-level caches from those fields. The raise is mostly not that one module. Measured main at 4660/6463 against the 4636/6413 baseline, so app.events had again drifted to exactly 50 of its 50-module tolerance and the next import of any size was going to fail whoever added it.
